desktop:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Primary request: A beautiful, polished, feasible Russian pixel-art preparation screen for the lighthouse defense game "Свет Авалона". This is a new UI DESIGN MOCKUP, not a promotional poster, no physical device mockup. Meticulous art direction, contemporary indie game quality, readable restrained interface.
References: the two supplied local images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: preserve their fine pixel clusters, blue slate stone material, chipped stepped bevels, pale warm lettering and amber light. Do NOT copy their horizon/side-view background or giant menu slabs. This screen uses a high oblique TOP-DOWN TACTICAL GAME CAMERA, all ground visible, no sky, no moon, no hero. Pixel art throughout including fine readable Cyrillic lettering, no smooth vector UI, no photographic/3D rendering, no blurry antialiased art. Fine pixel detail, controlled textures with quiet panel interiors.
World: chapter I "ТУМАННЫЙ БЕРЕГ". Muted blue-grey grassy coastal stone on LEFT, dark readable teal-blue ocean on RIGHT. A nearly straight shore runs vertically through the center of the world. Compact squat stone lighthouse with warm windows on that coast; small ancient ruined arch well beyond device placement. The lighthouse is a game object with visible base, not a towering illustration hiding units. Rocks, restrained foam and far-edge mist as decoration; play area bright enough for clear silhouettes. No enemies, no active fight, no sunrays. Two small bronze cannons and one low stone barrier are on land, distinct from scenery. One cannon slightly damaged with an unobtrusive segmented amber HP bar, other two healthy. These are free-positioned objects, no grid, no build sockets. Subtle dotted arc can indicate placement extent. Sea remains playable visible field.
Data examples exact: 136 shards and 3 Deep Pearls, chapter I night 2 "РАЗБИТЫЙ БЕРЕГ", 4 waves, placed objects 3/4 and types 2/2. Both counters have carefully designed pixel sprites: a small group of faceted warm pale-gold crystalline SHARDS, versus a single round iridescent ice-blue PEARL nestled in a dark shell. They are different currencies and very different shapes. No gold coins, no gems as a third currency, no energy, no shop + badges.
Visual hierarchy: calm blue stone secondary controls, restrained warm bevel edge, start button the most visible warm amber accent; never lots of gold glowing panels. Every icon has a concise legible Russian label. Comfortable finger-size buttons. No generic SaaS cards, no parchment, no enormous headings. Use only the specified text. No watermark.
Composition: ONE full-bleed wide 16:9 desktop game screen at high resolution (around 1920x1080), no surrounding artboard. Top approximately 10%: slim coherent dark chipped-stone toolbar, compact button "НАЗАД" at left, a two-line selectable chapter block "ГЛАВА I · ТУМАННЫЙ БЕРЕГ" and "НОЧЬ 2 · РАЗБИТЫЙ БЕРЕГ", central separate resource chips with shard sprite "136" and pearl sprite "3", right two generous labeled buttons with a carved branching upgrade rune "ДЕРЕВО" and a bronze spyglass sprite "РАЗВЕДКА".
Main 70%: the uninterrupted wide tactical coast as described; land and sea each occupy about half; lighthouse central, 2 cannons and barrier to its left. Very small top-left field label "ПОДГОТОВКА" and small top-right "4 ВОЛНЫ". No permanent panel on top of the sea, no side inventory tower. Adequate unoccupied land for editing positions.
Bottom approximately 20%, OUTSIDE the map: one compact low blue-slate preparation dock. Left section 3 distinct inventory sprite tiles, labeled "ПУШКА", "БАРЬЕР", "ЗАПАС" (reserve uses an orderly chest sprite); avoid any purchase price or forced purchase. Central two slim equipment chips: round faceted optic sprite with labels "ЛИНЗА" / "БАЗОВАЯ", and sunburst rune sprite with "СПОСОБНОСТЬ" / "ВСПЫШКА". Small separate clearly legible status line "Объекты 3/4 · Типы 2/2". Right section prominent warm-edged stone button exact "НАЧАТЬ НОЧЬ", beneath small quiet label "Расстановка и старт бесплатны". Text must remain readable. No selected-device contextual panel in this overview state. No exaggerated massive stone boulders taking the screen.

Composition: ONE full-bleed tall portrait 9:19.5 mobile game screen around 900x1950, no phone frame, no board. Responsive layout designed for 390 CSS pixel width. It must feel like the same game as the desktop design but not a squeezed desktop.
Top roughly 17%: first row a small readable "НАЗАД" button at left, then two resource counters shard sprite "136", pearl sprite "3"; no large title. Second row centered two lines "ГЛАВА I · ТУМАННЫЙ БЕРЕГ" and "НОЧЬ 2 · РАЗБИТЫЙ БЕРЕГ" with tiny selection chevron. Third row TWO equal generous stone action buttons with sprites "ДЕРЕВО" and "РАЗВЕДКА". Thin quiet line "ПОДГОТОВКА · 4 ВОЛНЫ".
The central 55% must be DIVIDED INTO TWO connected MAP VIEWPORTS showing exactly the SAME world at different scales:
1) UPPER MAP about 18% of total screen: a wide panoramic top-down OVERVIEW of the FULL coast including land, compact lighthouse and sea. Tiny label "ОБЗОР". A precise thin gold rectangular camera frame encloses the lighthouse and the land where two cannons and barrier stand. The rectangle is only a camera selection, not a build zone.
2) A thin slate divider labeled "КРУПНЫЙ ПЛАН" with a small expand-square button at right.
3) LOWER MAP about 32% of screen, significantly taller than overview: a clearly MAGNIFIED version of the exact framed area above, showing the same lighthouse at shoreline, the SAME two cannons and SAME barrier in identical relative positions, same land left/sea right, much larger readable sprites. No extra or missing units, no changed geography. The lighthouse itself occupies at most one third of the close-up map height. Subtle short amber arcs at cannon bases may indicate selection affordance. No card covering either map.
Bottom approximately 28%, outside map: short single line "Объекты 3/4 · Типы 2/2", then two side-by-side compact equipment tiles with optic sprite "ЛИНЗА" / "БАЗОВАЯ" and sunburst rune sprite "СПОСОБНОСТЬ" / "ВСПЫШКА". Then a low 3-tile inventory shelf with small attractive distinct pixel sprites and labels "ПУШКА", "БАРЬЕР", "ЗАПАС". Finally full-width comfortable stone button with warm amber bevel exact "НАЧАТЬ НОЧЬ", and tiny quiet footer "Расстановка и старт бесплатны". Keep bottom inside safe area. Every action comfortably touchable. No horizontal overflow, no extra words, no huge decorative top lighthouse or sky.
